reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, whether it is really tested. Pre-counted sachets are easy for my work trips, and $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try on impulse.
objection: Made in China. A report on the page is nice, but I cannot tell if the lab is real or if the report is for the batch I actually get.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code did not open a real report that matches the batch number on the box, I would not reorder, and I would ask for the refund.
